common.tagline: No one should have to go alone.

welcome.title: Someone nearby can be there.
welcome.line1: Teman connects people who need someone beside them with neighbours who have a few hours to give. Always free.
welcome.line2: You say what you need, or when you are free. Someone nearby answers.
welcome.line3: Verified neighbours, no payments, no ratings — just company.

verify.whyTitle: Why we ask for your ID
verify.whyFor: People decide to meet a stranger based on trust. A checked ID is the biggest part of that trust.
verify.whyWhoSees: One trained reviewer at our partner organisation sees it. Other members never do.
verify.whyRetention: After review, your photos are deleted within 90 days. We never keep your IC number — only a scrambled code used to spot duplicates.
verify.docPassportSub: If you are not a Malaysian citizen
verify.docNumberHint: Used only to spot the same document on two accounts. Never stored as-is.
verify.idGuide: All four corners visible, no glare. A photo you already have in your gallery is fine.
verify.idPromise: Reviewed by a person. Deleted after 90 days. Never shown to other members.
verify.selfieWhy: This confirms the account belongs to the person on the document. It is compared once by the reviewer, then deleted with the rest.
verify.submitFailed: That did not go through. Everything you entered is still here — try again.
verify.pendingWho: A coordinator at our partner organisation checks your photos against your name.
verify.pendingHowLong: Usually the same day during recruitment drives. We will tell you the moment it is decided.
verify.rejectedTitle: Your ID could not be accepted
verify.rejectedNoReason: No reason was recorded. Please try again.
verify.rejectedNext: This is fixable — most rejections are a blurry corner or a cut-off edge.
verify.rejectedHuman: If you believe this is wrong, tell the coordinator at your orientation session — a person will look at it with you.

safety.contactsLead: Someone who is told when a Teman session starts and ends, and who you can alert with one tap.
safety.contactsEmptyBody: Add one person you trust — a family member or a close friend. It makes every meeting safer, for both sides.
safety.contactPhoneHint: They get SMS updates. They do not need the app.
safety.contactInvalid: That does not look like a Malaysian mobile number.
safety.reportLead: A person reads every report, usually within a day. Serious reports stop that person from being matched immediately, before anyone has even read it.
safety.reportFailed: That did not go through. Everything you wrote is still here — try again.
safety.reportStep1: If this was serious, that person can no longer be matched with anyone — that has already happened.
safety.reportStep2: A person reads your report, usually within a day.
safety.reportStep3: You will be told what was decided.
safety.blockedRowSub: People who can never see you, and you never see them
safety.blockedEmptyBody: If you block someone, you disappear from each other completely.
safety.notEmergencyTitle: Teman is not an emergency service
safety.notEmergencyBody: If someone is in danger or needs medical help right now, call 999 first. Everything here sits alongside that, never instead of it.
safety.guidelinesTitle: How we keep each other safe
safety.g1Body: No payments, loans, tips or fees between members, in either direction, ever. If anyone asks you for money, report it — that is the single most common way people are taken advantage of.
safety.g2Body: A Teman keeps you company. They do not give medical advice, handle medication, or replace a nurse, a carer or a therapist.
safety.g3Body: Romantic or sexual approaches are against the rules, in messages and in person, and are a report category taken seriously.
safety.g4Body: Exact addresses and phone numbers are only shared after both sides accept, and every reveal is recorded. Never share banking details, PINs or OTP codes with anyone.
